ValidationRule.description: Requires Amount for opportunities with probability >= 50%
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Amount), Probability >= 50, NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Amount is required for opportunities in Proposal, Negotiation, or later stages.
